summary: Completed Module 09 CONTEXT micro-exercise: prioritized end-to-end multi-tenant isolation testing and identified database isolation safeguards to prevent test environment bleed.
evidence: Prioritized end-to-end tenant isolation test as the highest-value test, protecting against IDOR vulnerabilities, cross-tenant data leaks, and broken object-level authorization in B2B systems.
Analyzed the primary failure mode of test database bleed: unisolated .env files loading production connection strings into test runners.
Formulated production safeguards for test database isolation: dedicated test database instances, transaction rollbacks in fixtures, and fail-safe environment assertions.
